headline: Edo State Seals Nine Chinese-Owned Firms Over N8.98 Billion Tax Debt
summary: The Edo State Internal Revenue Service sealed off nine companies, including Rongtai Plastic Company Limited, over alleged outstanding tax liabilities totaling N8.982 billion.
why: Enforcement actions for tax compliance affect corporate operations and municipal revenue collection in regional commercial hubs.

impacts.name: Rongtai Plastic Company Limited
impacts.why: Facility closures due to tax debts disrupt business operations and inventory movement.
